content.general: This document is a clinical guideline from the 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline. It covers a range of diagnostic and treatment methods for aortic diseases, including imaging techniques such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), echocardiography, and intravascular ultrasound (IVUS). It discusses the assessment of aortic diameter, risk factors for dissection, and various strategies for managing thoracic aortic aneurysms.
